selected_evidence.requirement: At least 512 MB of compressed in-memory swap, preferred over disk-backed swap
selected_evidence.summary: Before and after reboot, zramctl showed /dev/zram0 using zstd with a 512 MiB capacity; /proc/swaps showed priority 100 versus disk swap priority -2.
The zram systemd service was enabled and active, then returned active after reboot with /dev/zram0 mounted as swap.

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart and recovery sequence
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot ID was 5f3ce3b8-4860-447e-bcf1-d6643718694e; the reboot was safely scheduled and acknowledged; the new boot ID was 9e2653ed-a30a-4661-9dda-eafaa72dd0a3; system state recovered to running with both swap devices healthy and no failed units.

commands.command:
set -eu
modprobe zram
printf 'device='; zramctl --find
printf 'algorithms='; cat /sys/block/zram0/comp_algorithm
printf 'current_size='; cat /sys/block/zram0/disksize
printf 'module_loaded='; lsmod | awk '$1 == "zram" {print $1, $2, $3}'

set -eu
cat > /etc/systemd/system/zram-swap.service <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Compressed in-memory zram swap
Documentation=man:zramctl(8) man:swapon(8)
After=systemd-modules-load.service
Before=swap.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
RemainAfterExit=yes
ExecStart=/usr/sbin/modprobe zram
ExecStart=/usr/sbin/zramctl --algorithm zstd --size 512M /dev/zram0
ExecStart=/usr/sbin/mkswap /dev/zram0
ExecStart=/usr/sbin/swapon --priority 100 /dev/zram0
ExecStop=-/usr/sbin/swapoff /dev/zram0
ExecStop=-/usr/sbin/zramctl --reset /dev/zram0

[Install]
WantedBy=swap.target
ANTRIEB_EOF
restorecon /etc/systemd/system/zram-swap.service
systemd-analyze verify /etc/systemd/system/zram-swap.service
printf 'unit_written='; stat -c '%n %a %U:%G' /etc/systemd/system/zram-swap.service
